title: Gunfire erupts in occupied West Bank settler attack
html:
Gunfire erupts in occupied West Bank settler attack

Israeli settlers opened fire in the village of al Duyuk near Jericho killing one woman and injuring several other Palestinians. In early November, a group of settlers moved into Palestinian homes in Jericho, and prevented the owners from entering their properties.
summary: Israeli settlers opened fire in the village of al Duyuk near Jericho killing one woman and injuring several others.
